title: Maps from a weakly contractible affine to finite constant objects
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and let $U$ be an affine object that is weakly contractible, meaning that for every epimorphism $F	o G$ of sheaves of sets on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, the map $F(U)	o G(U)$ is surjective. For every profinite set $S$, write $X[S]$ for the pro-etale object obtained as the inverse limit of finite disjoint unions of copies of $X$ indexed by finite quotients of $S$. The connected-component quotient $\pi_0(|U|)$, with its quotient topology, is profinite, and there is a natural bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_X(U,X[S])\cong C(\pi_0(|U|),S)$, compatible with maps in $S$ and with morphisms between such $U$.
